title: yenc.rs: duplicate find_yend_end scan after successful decode
description: mime-tree/src/yenc.rs calls yencoding::decode() to obtain the decoded data, then calls find_yend_end() to scan the same input slice a second time to determine how many bytes were consumed. This means every yEnc block is scanned twice. find_yend_end is a linear scan for the =yend line in bytes the decoder already processed. The fix is for yencoding::decode() to return the consumed byte count alongside the decoded data, eliminating the rescan. As-is, decoding a large yEnc binary attachment touches the encoded bytes twice.
close_reason: P2 efficiency: the duplicate find_yend_end scan is a few microseconds on typical Usenet article bodies (< 1 MB). Not a hot path.
